data.other_hard: SAT or ACT test scores must be submitted; FAFSA must be completed; transfer students must graduate from a 2-year community or junior college and attend only 1 college before Miles
data.evidence_sentence: If you elect not to send a test score, you will not be eligible.
data.notes: Page lists several awards (Presidential, Dean's, Bridge) with different required GPA, test scores and award amounts, so per-award criteria are not filled; Presidential covers tuition, room/board and books, Dean's total $20,000 and Bridge total $10,000. Required GPA figures (3.7, 3.2, 2.75) and the 3.5/3.3/2.5 cumulative GPAs apply to renewal or per-award thresholds and are not whole-page entry requirements. Renewal requires 15 hours per semester and a cumulative GPA. Page also describes the Alabama G.I. Dependents' Scholarship Program, a separate program with its own residency and FAFSA rules; it is not included. No deadline or nationality rule is stated. Page text is truncated at the end.
